{"id":1609556637,"question_id":279,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1744896646,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1609556637/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Perfect Squares","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int recursion(int n)\n    {\n        //base case\n        if(n == 0) return 1;\n        if(n < 0) return 0;\n\n        //ek case hum solve karenge baaki recursion sambhalega\n        int ans = INT_MAX;\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i <= sqrt(n) ; i++)\n        {\n            int square = i * i;\n            int count = 1 + recursion(n - square);\n            if(count < ans)\n            {\n                ans = count;\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n    int numSquares(int n) {\n        return recursion(n) - 1; \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"perfect-squares","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":564}
